senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּבַל) to clasp, fasten. Part. pass. כָּבוּן, f. כְּבוּנָה, pl. כְּבוּנוֹת clasped, esp. sheep wearing a clasped cover (v. כְּבֵינְתָּא) for the protection of their wool.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:2">Sabb. V, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:1">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:1">V</cite>), 1 <he>כ׳ למילת</he> covered for the sake of the fine wool. Bab.

senses.gloss: to clasp a wrap; to wrap up. Sabb. l. c., v. supra. Ib. (defining צמר לבן) כצמר נקי … שמְכַבְּנִין אוֹתוֹ למילת like the wool of a new-born lamb which they wrap up for the sake of the wool; Shebu. 6ᵇ שמכבנין אותו Ms. M. (ed. incorr. בו).
